control.controlName: Ensure Cloud Storage buckets are not public
control.manualRemediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers IAM bindings and enable Public Access Prevention on the bucket.
control.cliRemediation:
gsutil pap set enforced gs://<bucket>
gsutil iam ch -d allUsers gs://<bucket>
control.rationale: Public buckets expose object data to anyone (allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers).

control.manualRemediation: Delete the default VPC network in each project and create purpose-built networks with least-privilege firewall rules.
control.rationale: The auto-created default network has permissive firewall rules; deleting it reduces attack surface.
